description: Manually check this workspace's existing letter and postcard inboxes now, between scheduled runs. This is the website's Check now/Refresh action for both email services; it is not postcard-only. Production key required. Processes up to ten emails per inbox within the shared time limit, with the same matching, approval, authorized autosend, budget and duplicate safeguards as scheduled checks. Existing consented autosend can purchase postage; this tool grants no new consent. A shared worker lease prevents overlapping checks. Server enforces a 60-second cooldown per workspace, including failed attempts; retryAfterSeconds indicates when to retry. Respects admin and workspace pauses. Returns processed count, morePending, updated workspace and demo state; no mailbox credentials.
name: check_email_box
title: Check Email Box
